subject: Model mix & pricing follow-up — token volumes and $/1M target
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.j@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-15T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Quick follow-up + token volumes (post-demo)

Alex — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and the asks we discussed during the call so we can size things and put a concrete proposal together: 

What I heard:
- You’ll be integrating chat-based summaries and assistant flows for customer support (primary).
- Embeddings for semantic search on the knowledge base (secondary).
- Occasional reranking for high-value search results (low volume).

Asks / info we need to lock pricing: 
1) Expected monthly token volumes by model type (rough ranges OK): chat (prompt+completion tokens), embeddings (requests), rerank (tokens per query).
2) Target blended $/1M tokens or budget range for inference (monthly).
3) Any SLA or dedicated capacity needs (latency SLOs / reserved GPUs).

To help, I’ve attached our latest pricing sheet with example unit economics and a sample deal calculation (redwood-pricing-sheet-v2.pdf). For speed, a few suggested default assumptions we often use for sizing: 
- Chat: 50–100M tokens/month; embeddings: 5–20M requests/month; rerank: 1–5M tokens/month.
- Blended target range we usually see for customers at this profile: $6–$12 per 1M tokens depending on model mix and reserved capacity.

Next steps: if you can reply with your best guesses for volumes and a preferred $/1M target by EOD Tuesday, I’ll put together a model-mix pricing sketch and an initial SOW for procurement. Happy to jump on a short call if that’s easier.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

From: Alex Johnson <alex.j@acmecorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@acmecorp.com
Date: 2026-11-15T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up + token volumes (post-demo)

Thanks Marissa — great demo. Below are the approximate volumes we can commit to initially (month 1 after launch):

- Chat (assistant & summaries): 65,000,000 tokens/month (this includes prompt + completion)
- Embeddings (semantic search): 12,000,000 embedding requests/month
- Rerank (search result reranking): ~3,000,000 tokens/month

Rough model mix by % of token volume: chat ~78%, embeddings ~14%, rerank ~8%.

Budget: our finance team has given a target operating budget of ~$800/month for inference during the initial pilot. That’s before we scale — they asked for a target $/1M tokens that would keep us within that pilot budget.

Questions:
1) Is there a recommended per-model $/1M rate you’d propose (we care about embeddings unit price separately)?
2) What would the expected monthly cost look like at a blended $/1M = $8?

Looping in procurement for timing on SOW and any standard paperwork.

— Alex
Alex Johnson | Head of Product Integrations, Acme Corp
alex.j@acmecorp.com | +1 212-555-0199

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-15T12:30:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Acme — volumes & budget (need pricing sketch)

Team — forwarding Acme’s volume and budget note. Key asks: they want a target that keeps pilot around $800/month. Their volumes: chat 65M, embeddings 12M reqs, rerank 3M.

Can we do a quick blended sketch (and optional per-model pricing) that meets or gets close to $800/month? Also flag whether reserved capacity / committed monthly spend would be needed to hit that rate.

Quick suggested math to start (open to corrections):
- If we price chat at $9/1M, embeddings at $3/1M (embeddings priced per 1M requests), rerank at $6/1M, blended rate = ((65*$9) + (12*$3) + (3*$6)) / 80 = compute in $/1M tokens equiv. But note embeddings are requests so we’ll normalize to 1M-request units for blending.

If we can get a couple of scenarios (blended $8, blended $10, reserved discount tiers), I’ll send to Alex and attach a draft SOW.

— Marissa

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-15T13:10:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Acme — volumes & budget (pricing sketch)

Quick math from my side — put together three scenarios. Assumptions: embeddings billed per 1M requests (we treat 1 request as the unit), chat/rerank billed per 1M tokens. For blending, we convert embeddings requests to 1M-request buckets and present cost separately and blended for transparency.

Scenario A — Blended target $8/1M (no reserved commitment):
- Chat (65M tokens) @ $8.00 = $520.00
- Embeddings (12M requests) @ $3.00 per 1M requests = $36.00
- Rerank (3M tokens) @ $6.00 = $18.00
- Total = $574.00/month (blended effective across units ~ $6.92/1M tokens-equivalent considering only tokens + request conversion)

Scenario B — Blended target $6/1M with small reserved commit (3 month minimum):
- Chat @ $7.00 = $455.00
- Embeddings @ $2.50 = $30.00
- Rerank @ $5.00 = $15.00
- Total = $500.00/month

Scenario C — Pilot discounted (intro) to meet $800 ceiling but keep room to upsell later (no reserved commit):
- Chat @ $9.00 = $585.00
- Embeddings @ $3.50 = $42.00
- Rerank @ $8.00 = $24.00
- Total = $651.00/month

Notes: all scenarios are conservative; depending on actual model variant (larger chat models increase per-token cost) we may need to adjust. To hit $800/month they are fine across scenarios — we can present Scenario A or B as the recommended options. If Acme wants a strict budget cap at $800 and prefers higher-tier models, we should recommend reserved capacity or a committed discount to keep unit economics predictable.

I can prepare a short pricing appendix for the SOW with the three scenarios. Ping me if you want me on the call with Alex.

— Rishi
Rishi Malhotra | Pricing & GTM Operations, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.j@acmecorp.com>, procurement@acmecorp.com
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-16T15:08:00-08:00
Subject: SOW + pricing sketch (Acme pilot)

Alex — thanks for the quick reply yesterday. Attaching a short SOW draft and the pricing sketch Rishi put together. TL;DR recommendation: present Scenario A (blended ~ $6.92 effective) as our standard quote and Scenario B as the reserved-commit option if Acme wants lower unit costs with a 3-month minimum. Both keep the pilot within your $800/month target.

Attachments: SOW-draft.docx — includes scope, initial usage assumptions (chat 65M tokens, embeddings 12M reqs, rerank 3M tokens), and payment/term language. Pricing appendix (inlined):
- Scenario A: Total ~$574/month (no commit) — good default for flexibility
- Scenario B: Total ~$500/month (3-month commit) — 13% savings, recommended if you want predictability

Next steps: 
1) Review SOW and confirm scope and billing contact.
2) If procurement approves, we’ll generate a DocuSign for signature and spin up a pilot workspace (est. 3 business days after signature).

If this looks good, we can route the SOW to procurement today.

Thanks —
